author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
**Verdict: Data entry / input question.**

The input row has `state=20`, which is Maine in TAXSIM's SOI coding (`20me.for`; Montana is 27) — so PE produced a Maine return, and the `srebate=850.0` already in the bundle's output.txt is Maine's $850 relief payment (booked to 2021 under the liability-year convention, #1068), not a missing Montana rebate. Was `state=27` intended?

Re-run with `state=27`, current PE does apply the 2021 Montana rebate: `srebate = 103.77` = lesser of $1,250 or this record's 2021 MT liability (~$103), per [MCA 15-30-2191](https://archive.legmt.gov/bills/mca/title_0150/chapter_0300/part_0210/section_0910/0150-0300-0210-0910.html); PE models it in [`mt_income_tax_rebate`](https://github.com/PolicyEngine/policyengine-us/blob/master/policyengine_us/variables/gov/states/mt/tax/income/credits/rebate/mt_income_tax_rebate.py).

| Run | siitax | srebate |
|---|---|---|
| state=20 (ME, as submitted) | −1,280.40 | 850.00 |
| state=27 (MT) | −45.06 | 103.77 |

Separately — the bundled Form 2 PDF (wages 7,789; taxable income 149,756; tax 9,734) doesn't match this row's inputs (pwages 10,476; intrec 656). Possible the PDF is from a different case? For the PDF's return, the rebate would be the full $1,250.
